Cork, captained by [[Ger FitzGerald (hurler)|Ger FitzGerald]], won the game by 1–22 to 3–11.{{cite web|url=http://munster.gaa.ie/history/sh_teams/|title=Munster Final Winning Teams|work=Munster.gaa.ie|accessdate=23 June 2011|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20110721124423/http://munster.gaa.ie/history/sh_teams/|archivedate=21 July 2011|url-status=dead}} ==Route to the final== ===Cork=== {{football box |date=24 May
